item.title: CASABLANCA PRESS: THE FLYING MONKEYS PROJECT — Mon Nov 9, 6:30 PM — NJ
item.description: The term "flying monkeys" — borrowed from the Wicked Witch's enforcers in The Wizard of Oz — refers to people who a narcissist recruits, whether consciously or unconsciously, to extend their reach, control, and influence beyond what they can achieve alone. Flying monkeys carry messages, gather information, deliver guilt or pressure, spread false narratives, and otherwise serve the narcissist's agenda, often while believing they are simply helping or mediating a conflict. “Flying Monkeys in Narcissistic Abuse: What They Are and How to Protect Yourself” ( Simply Psychology ) This project is based on a book that I have started writing, titled The ABCs of Trump’s Flying Monkeys. item.title: Verona Park — Sat Nov 14, 9:30 AM
item.description:
Let's Walk!! JOIN US FOR A WALK
We will meet at the benches in front of the boathouse.
We will walk the loop around the park. The goal will be at least three miles, but there is plenty of opportunity to stop or continue to fit your personal goals.
We will be walking on a **paved surface.**
We walk at a **medium speed**. As always, we will go at a moderate pace and won’t leave anyone behind. But **please be considerate** of others if you don't think you will be able to walk at a moderate pace for the duration.
Please plan to arrive 5 minutes **early** so that we can **start on time.**
Verona Park is 54.32 acres with a lake running through it. It is bordered by Lakeside and Bloomfield Avenues in the southern part of Verona. It is the fifth largest park in the Essex County system, making it a great place to walk.
